homeIntro: Sekoya Parts brings together {products} spare parts for household appliances, from belts to circuit boards, sorted into {categories} categories. Each page gives the price and the list of compatible appliance models, up to a million for a single part, so you find the right part the first time.
searchHint: Enter your appliance’s model number, as shown on its rating plate, to find its page and the parts that fit it.
searchMoreModels: Only the first {count} appliances are shown: type more of the model number to narrow the list.
searchMoreParts: Only the first {count} parts are shown: refine the search to narrow it down.
searchPartsUnavailable: Part search is unavailable for now. The appliances above can still be browsed.
modelIntro: Spare parts compatible with the {model} model ({appliance}). Each page below gives the price in euros and the full list of compatible models, so you can check that a part fits this appliance before choosing it.
categoryIntro: Category {category}: {count} spare parts, sorted by reference. Each page gives the price in euros and the list of compatible appliance models, so you can check that a part fits your appliance before choosing it.
